parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program

ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Open Seminar
ns2:course.description: An experimental course on a special topic in agricultural leadership, education and communications. Same as AGED 199. May be repeated in the same or separate terms as topics vary to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: ALEC Program approval required.
